issues.description: Function name mismatch for the distillation-circuit constructor: the problem statement (and tests) declare and expect a function named build_msd_circ(circ: stim.Circuit, distilled_state: int, y_states: list[int]) -> tuple[list[int], list[int]] (see problem_statement.md). The provided template defines a different identifier, build_msd_circuit(...), in the starter file msd.py. The solution repository implements the expected name build_msd_circ(...). This inconsistent identifier will cause students to implement or call the wrong function name (or have tests fail because build_msd_circ is missing), creating import/test failures and confusion about the required API.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the identifier consistent across problem statement, template, and tests. Either (a) rename the template function build_msd_circuit(...) to build_msd_circ(...) with the exact signature (circ, distilled_state: int, y_states: list[int]) -> tuple[list[int], list[int]], or (b) add a thin compatibility wrapper in the template: def build_msd_circ(circ, distilled_state, y_states): return build_msd_circuit(circ, distilled_state, y_states). Ensure the wrapper/signature and return type match the specification so tests that call build_msd_circ succeed.
